use_case_name: Respond to a Second-Chance Purchase Offer

claims.content: To allow a customer to accept or decline a Second-Chance Offer for an item they did not win in an auction.

goal.raw_text: To allow a customer to accept or decline a Second-Chance Offer for an item they did not win in an auction.

claims.content: The customer must have participated in an auction where they were outbid or did not win the item.
The seller must have enabled the 'Second-Chance Offer' feature for that specific auction item.
The seller must have initiated a Second-Chance Offer to the customer for the specific item.
The customer must have received a notification (via email or within their JTV account) regarding the Second-Chance Offer.
The Second-Chance Offer must still be valid and not expired (typically valid for 7 days from issuance).

The use case is triggered when a customer receives an email notification from eBay stating that although they did not win the auction, the seller has additional inventory and is offering them a 'Second Chance' to purchase the item at their maximum bid price.

trigger.raw_text: The use case is triggered when a customer receives an email notification from eBay stating that although they did not win the auction, the seller has additional inventory and is offering them a 'Second Chance' to purchase the item at their maximum bid price.

claims.content: The customer receives an email notification from eBay regarding a Second-Chance Offer for an item they did not win.
The customer clicks on the link in the email which directs them to the JTV website's 'Second-Chance Offers' page.
The system displays the details of the Second-Chance Offer, including the item description, the offer price (typically the customer's maximum bid), and the expiration date of the offer.
The customer reviews the offer and decides whether to accept or decline it.
If the customer chooses to accept the offer, they click the 'Accept' button.
The system processes the acceptance and creates a new order for the item at the offered price.
The system confirms the successful purchase to the customer via an on-screen message and/or a confirmation email.
Alternatively, if the customer chooses to decline the offer, they click the 'Decline' button.
The system records the declination and removes the offer from the customer's active offers list.
